svg.title: Parachute architecture diagram
svg.desc: System architecture showing the full flow from user through InsurancePool and ClaimAgent contracts to Somnia agents and CoinGecko API, with payout path back to user

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the user do in Parachute?')
sendPrompt('How does InsurancePool.sol work in Parachute?')
g.text: Holds funds · stores policies · triggers payouts

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does ClaimAgent.sol work in Parachute?')
g.text: Runs on hourly schedule · evaluates policies

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the JSON API agent do in Parachute?')
sendPrompt('What does the LLM agent do in Parachute?')
sendPrompt('What CoinGecko API endpoint does Parachute use?')
sendPrompt('How does Parachute pay out when a policy triggers?')
g.text: Sent to user instantly if price breached
